description: This file contains definitions for building kernel modules/packages for the Linux kernel, specifically related to Freescale QorIQ AHCI SATA support and Freescale PPFE driver support. It defines package metadata, dependencies, file locations, and auto-loading configurations.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ahci-qoriq
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Freescale QorIQ AHCI SATA support.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ahci-qoriq/description
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the ahci-qoriq kernel package.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ppfe
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Freescale PPFE driver support.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ppfe/description
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the ppfe kernel package.
